IGNITION - IGNITION COIL
REMOVAL
1. REMOVE NO. 2 CYLINDER HEAD COVER
2. REMOVE IGNITION COILS (WITH IGNITER) FROM
SPARK PLUGS
(a) Remove the 2 bolts and disconnect the wire harness pro­
tector.
(b) Disconnect the 4 ignition coil connectors.
(c) Remove the 4 bolts and pull out the 4 ignition coils (with
igniter).
